title: 第二十章   巨猿发怒
content_zh:
月亮挂在枝头，让清冷的夜色有些许撩人。清风摇晃着柳枝，让他在秋水中，洗尽一天的风尘。

    “上次不是找过了吗？”芊芊一边走抱怨道。

    离开招摇城后，墨非夜还是念念不忘，雨归尘口中的萨满和灾兽。上次查探途中，因遇到冰夷意外中断，他想在离开之前，再去找寻一番。

    众人与上次一样，沿河搜寻，希望能发有新的发现。

    “你说在碰到冰夷怎么办，那斯垂涎本姑娘的美貌，要是真被捉了去，你可亏大了，我的夜。”

    相对起芊芊东戳戳，西扫扫的搜索方式，墨非夜要仔细得多，每棵树都要仔细地查看。

    “你的夜会吃什么亏？”墨攻行看起来漫不经心，但对比起墨非夜，其实他的搜索效率更高。在与芊芊聊天的同时，他已经用技能，将周围丈余的情况，侦查得明明白白，有几个老鼠洞，洞里有几只老鼠，他都尽览无遗。

    与其说是技能不如说是一种天赋，这种方法需要一种与生俱来的能力，精神力。

    “你是猪吗？”芊芊翘着嘴：“都知道那冰夷的德行，本姑娘这貌美如花的，被他捉去，都知道他想干些什么龌龊勾当。”

    芊芊突然停了下来，好像在努力地思考什么。

    沉寂了片刻，芊芊美黛紧锁说道：“要真是这样，那生出来的是鱼，还是人？要是鱼，那岂不是像鱼那样，一窝窝的。”

    “你马上就知道了。”墨攻行吓唬道，示意芊芊看向丽麂水的方向。

    透着月光，看到丽麂水旁的芦苇中，漂浮着一个柱形物体，要不是被芦苇群阻挡，估计就会继续顺河而下。

    “我的夜，那是什么？”芊芊指着水中叫道。

    “好像是一个人。”墨非夜连忙跑过去，将他捞了起来。

    “这？”芊芊看着捞上来的尸体，不知道说些什么。

    只能用惨无忍睹来形容，尸体虽然已经被烧得碳化，可尸体手中紧握的长剑和身上多处伤痕，可以看出生前曾经进行过残酷的战斗。

    不知道是因为被烧得肌肉萎缩，还是生前的信念，尸体手中的长剑，让墨非夜无法取下，最后还要身为墨匠的墨攻行出马，才取了下来。

    “这把剑有些眼熟。”

    墨非夜端视着长剑，发现剑柄上雕刻着花纹。

    “这些花纹，好像在哪里见过。”墨攻行指着剑柄说道。

    从剑上可以看出，死者曾经受过的痛苦，整把剑被一层油脂覆盖，被烧成黑糊糊的一团，可想而知当时的情景是多么残酷，可就算烈火焚身，万千痛苦的情况下，死者都没有松开手中的剑。

    一番清洗后，剑露出了真容，也看出了这把剑的不凡，在这种情况下，剑身没有留下一点痕迹，剑刃依旧寒砺入双，冷光四射。

    “这是万风良的剑。”墨攻行指着剑柄中间的火莲。

    墨非夜和芊芊也认出了这把剑的来历。

    剑是万风良的剑，就算焦尸已经被烧得无法确认，但是无需质疑肯定是万风良。

    “剑宗弟子，剑在人在！”这是剑宗弟子入门的誓言，万风良忠实地履行的誓言。

    人亡剑依在！
content_en:
The moon hangs on the branches, making the cold night a little alluring. The breeze swayed the willow branches, allowing him to wash away the dust of the day in the autumn water.

    "Didn't you look for it last time?" Qianqian complained as she walked away.

    After leaving Zhaoyao City, Mo Feiye still couldn't forget the shaman and disaster beast mentioned by Yu Guichen. During his last investigation, he was unexpectedly interrupted due to encountering Bingyi, so he wanted to search for it again before leaving.

    Like last time, everyone searched along the river, hoping to make new discoveries.

    "What are you going to do when you meet Bingyi? Nassi covets my beauty. If you are really caught, you will be in big trouble, my night."

    Compared with Qianqian's searching method of poking in the east and sweeping in the west, Mo Feiye was much more careful, checking every tree carefully.

    "What will happen to your Yehui?" Mo Gongxing looked careless, but compared to Mo Feiye, his search efficiency was actually higher. While chatting with Qianqian, he had already used his skills to detect the surrounding situation clearly. There were several mouse holes and how many mice were in the holes. He could see them all.

    More of a talent than a skill, this method requires an innate ability, mental strength.

    "Are you a pig?" Qianqian curled her lips: "Everyone knows about Bingyi's virtues. Even if I, a beautiful girl like a flower, was captured by him, we all know what dirty deeds he wants to do."

    Qianqian suddenly stopped, as if thinking hard about something.

    After a moment of silence, Qianqian Meidai said tightly: "If this is true, are the babies born a fish or a human? If it is a fish, wouldn't it be like a fish, living in a nest?"

    "You'll know soon." Mo Gengxing threatened, gesturing Qianqian to look in the direction of Li Qishui.

    Under the moonlight, I saw a cylindrical object floating among the reeds beside the Liji River. If it were not blocked by the reeds, it would probably continue to flow down the river.

    "My night, what is that?" Qianqian pointed at the water and shouted.

    "It seems to be a person." Mo Feiye quickly ran over and picked him up.

    "This?" Qianqian looked at the recovered body and didn't know what to say.

    It can only be described as horrific. Although the corpse had been burned to carbonization, the sword held tightly in the corpse's hand and the multiple scars on its body showed that it had been a brutal battle before it was born.

    Whether it was due to muscle atrophy due to being burned or the belief he held while alive, Mo Feiye could not take off the long sword in the corpse's hand. In the end, Mo Gongxing, an ink master, had to step in to take it off.

    "This sword looks familiar."

    Mo Feiye looked at the sword and found patterns carved on the hilt.

    "These patterns seem to have been seen somewhere before." Mo Gongxing pointed to the hilt of the sword and said.

    It can be seen from the sword that the deceased has suffered pain. The whole sword was covered with a layer of grease and burned into a black mass. You can imagine how cruel the scene was at that time, but even though the fire burned his body and he was in countless pain, the deceased did not let go of the sword in his hand.

    After some cleaning, the sword revealed its true appearance, and the extraordinary nature of the sword was revealed. In this case, the sword body did not leave any traces, and the blade was still cold and radiant.

    "This is Wan Fengliang's sword." Mo Jinxing pointed to the fire lotus in the middle of the sword's hilt.

    Mo Feiye and Qianqian also recognized the origin of the sword.

    The sword was Wan Fengliang's sword. Even if the charred corpse was so burned that it was impossible to confirm, there was no doubt that it was Wan Fengliang.

    "Disciples of the Sword Sect, the sword is with you!" This is the oath taken by the disciples of the Sword Sect, and Wan Fengling faithfully fulfills it.

    The sword of death is still there!
